import bpy,bmesh,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;cap=root/'captures/shipyard_bank_integration_20261115';craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
checks=[]
def ck(name,v):
 assert v,name
 checks.append(name)
ck('Masonry and shore edits present',craft.get('bank15_masonry') and craft.get('bank15_shore'))
ck('60 new bearing stones',sum(o.get('bank15_stone',False) for o in craft.objects)==60)
ck('16 working slabs retained',sum(o.name.startswith('M14 working flag') for o in craft.objects)==16)
ck('8 long slot copings retained',sum(o.name.startswith('S15 long slot coping') for o in craft.objects)==8)
ck('3 side stairs retained',sum(o.name.startswith('M14 shore stair') for o in craft.objects)==3)
ck('49 local leaves retained',sum(o.get('stone15_plant',False) for o in craft.objects)==49)
bad=[]
for o in craft.objects:
 if not (o.get('bank15_stone') or o.get('bank15_lumber_bed')):continue
 bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(o.data);invalid=sum(not e.is_manifold for e in bm.edges);volume=bm.calc_volume(signed=True);bm.free()
 if invalid or volume<=0:bad.append([o.name,invalid,volume])
ck('New stones closed with positive volume',not bad)
bank=bpy.data.objects['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank']
ck('GroundTint present',bool(bank.data.color_attributes.get('GroundTint')))
ck('Previous unused seabed trim retained',bank.get('ground15_trimmed_buried_perimeter')==3573)
ck('Two lumber beds retained',sum(o.get('bank15_lumber_bed',False) for o in craft.objects)==2)
ck('Source saved',not bpy.data.is_dirty)
result={'checks':checks,'editable_objects':len(craft.objects),'stone_bad_edges_or_volume':bad,'bank_vertices':len(bank.data.vertices),'bank_faces':len(bank.data.polygons)}
(cap/'source_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
print('B15_SOURCE',len(checks),'passed',result)
